meta.title: AI Chatbot & Agents for Amazon Bedrock: demo mode
meta.description: A small bakery site with the chat on it. Without an AWS account the chat answers in demo mode, quoting the passage of the site's pages that best matches each question.
meta.author: noteflowai

options.blogdescription: Bread and pastries, baked every morning
